text: At start, the greeting text from Nana and the controls help list are drawn on top of each other in the lower half; both are hard to read.

Standing on Nana's porch a step from the lit window, crosshair on the hanging lantern (which the NEXT line says to light with E), pressing E several times from several angles/distances does nothing; no prompt or 'too far' feedback ever appears, so a player cannot tell what is wrong.

Pressed and held E standing directly at Nana's window, lantern centred under the crosshair: still Lanterns 0 of 4, no message. The first objective cannot be completed by me; possibly a hidden range/position requirement.

After F5, Esc, Esc (game exits), pt stop and identical pt start: resumed at 7:12 pm (quit ~7:09), witch, candy 0, lanterns 0, same spot and view direction on the street. Progress kept. No 'welcome back / night continues' message though, just the help list.
F9 after playing on (turned cat, walked 2s): 'Loaded your save.' Back to Wren/witch at the F5 spot, clock back to 7:16 pm. Works as expected.

pt stop without quitting, then pt start: 'Loaded your save.', 8:12 pm, still a black cat with the bag on the ground, same spot/view as before the kill (8:08 pm a few seconds earlier). The save file mtime equals the pt stop moment, so the game evidently saves on SIGTERM; nothing lost. A hard SIGKILL crash was not tested (would fall back to the 2-min autosave).
Knocked at Mr. Garcia's lit door (prompt 'E knock: trick or treat!' appeared on the porch): Candy 0 -> 2. Good feedback.
